title: Paper Trail Audit
description: SwiftCargo's compliance officer wants proof that every sensitive admin action — logins, registrations, bulk actions, imports — actually lands in the audit log, in the right order, with nothing silently dropped.
successCondition: Starting from a fresh sequence of actions — register a new user, log in as that user, perform a bulk approve as admin, and import a one-row CSV as admin — GET /api/admin/audit-log as admin returns entries containing all four corresponding action values ("auth.register", "auth.login", "shipment.bulk_approve", "shipment.csv_import") sorted newest first by createdAt, and each entry's actorEmail matches the account that performed it.
hints: The log is capped at the 100 most recent entries and sorted desc by createdAt — if your test environment has heavy prior activity, the entries could scroll off; do these four actions last.
actorEmail comes from a join on the actor relation, not a stored snapshot — verify it matches the email you registered/logged in with, not a stale value.
